articles.title: Pope's South American trip to go ahead following lung cancer surgery - BBC
articles.description: The Pope underwent surgery in to remove a tumour on the lower part of his right lung and is gradually resuming his duties.
articles.content: Peru's Cardinal Castillo, the Archbishop of Lima, has said the trip would involve young people, women who help run community kitchens and members of the country's indigenous communities, according to… [+13 chars]
